error.webhook_token_in_use: This webhook token is already in use by another instance. Please use a different token.

messages.device_tracker_help: Select the device_tracker used to detect the vehicle's location (example: device_tracker.my_phone).
messages.person_help: Person associated with the vehicle (used for notifications), e.g. person.john.
messages.notifier_help: Select the notify service to use (e.g. mobile_app_your_phone, telegram).
messages.tolerance_help: Tolerance radius in meters used to detect movement vs. small GPS variation (example: 200).
messages.activation_mode_help: Choose activation mode: 'connection' (save on disconnect), 'position' (save after stable location), 'combined' (both), 'manual' (manual saves).
messages.tag_model_help: Bluetooth tag model – some models report coordinates differently (e.g. Samsung SmartTag, Tile).
messages.webhook_help: Optional: enter a custom webhook token (e.g. my-token-123), or leave empty to have one generated.
messages.control_description: Use the buttons to start/stop the guard or trigger a save.
messages.debug_help: Enable verbose debug logs (useful for troubleshooting).
messages.stationary_help: Stationary checks: how long and how many samples to consider a stable position before saving.
